newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Foreign Minister Qian in HK for handover.
newsitem.headline: China Foreign Minister Qian in HK for handover.

text.p: Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen, one of the architects of Hong Kong's handover, flew in for the historic event on Sunday and plunged straight into talks with the territory's future leader Tung Chee-hwa.
Qian was greeted by Tung, colonial Chief Secretary Anson Chan, who will be staying on in her post after the handover, and China's senior diplomat in the territory Zhao Jihua.
Qian swept past reporters and went with Tung straight from the airport to a harbourfront hotel in Hung Hom on the Kowloon peninsula.

The minister is one of the Chinese leaders taking part in a grand handover ceremony at midnight on Monday when Britain's Prince Charles will hand the 156-year-old colony to China's President Jiang Zemin.
Britain grabbed Hong Kong from China in mid-19th century wars over the opium trade.
